title: ui predicate harvest: `record.?x` (CEL optional) is not harvested, and kanban/calendar/gantt queries may not take the harvest at all
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① a measured gap in the view projection harvest, named as follow-up D.2 of the #29094 ruling (option A, maintainer 「同意」, ruling comment 6579342813). It does not block anything, so it is filed as p3.
Reader: `domain:ui`, `ui/packages/core/src/utils/predicate-fields.ts` and the views that build their own queries.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "harvest record.?" and "predicate-fields harvest kanban" → #28542 (open, cloud invitations page projection), #28960 (closed, docs). Neither covers these two gaps.
reach: a list or board view whose action `visible` / `disabled` reads a field the view does not show.
type: Bug

Business reason: the harvest is what keeps a sparse list row from hiding a button by accident. A predicate it does not read, or a view that does not use it, puts the author back on the `has()` guard without any sign that this happened.

## What the code does on `main`
- `RECORD_REF = /\b(?:record|data)\.([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)/g` (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/predicate-fields.ts` line 91). The CEL optional spelling `record.?status` does not match it, so `status` is not harvested.
- The decision analysis for #29094 (§2.2 item 4) notes that kanban, calendar and gantt build their own queries, and that whether they take the harvest is not verified.

## Wanted
1. Make the regex accept `record.?x` and `data.?x`, and pin it.
2. Read the kanban, calendar and gantt views' queries. Wherever a view that renders row actions does not take the harvest, wire it in, or file the gap. Keep the field-level-security filter, because a harvest is not a read grant.
